_comment: Permanent redirects served by the CloudFront viewer-request function. Each `from` is matched exactly; `to` is site-relative and may carry a fragment. The target must be live before the redirect is published. The first publish, on 14 November 2026, was made with an empty list (a no-change swap of the hand-written function for the generated one). The five rows below are the Real Bot withdrawal's; scripts/stamp-withdrawal.sh dates them on the day the withdrawal ships. The storefront rebuild's rows come with that change. The deploy workflow refuses to publish while any row still carries a placeholder date.
